# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 1812532134, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> a polished black obsidian slab lying on a scholar's wooden desk, glowing violet threads linking dozens of floating parchment notes into a web above it, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
